(a) Lahore Session of Congress was held in December, 1929 and Gandhi-Irwin Pact was signed on 5 March, 1931 while execution of Bhagat Singh, Sukhdev and Rajguru 23 March, 1931 Karachi session of Congress (29-31 March, 1931). Thus, correct answer is option (a). 239. Match List- I with List- II and select the correct answer from the code given below: List- I List- II A. Subhas Chandra Bose 1. Throwing of the bomb in Central Assembly B. Vallabhbhai Patel 2. Haripura Session of Indian National Con- gress C. Iqbal 3. Operation Polo D. Batukeshwar Dutt 4. Allahabad Session of Muslim League, 1930 Code : A B C D (a) 2 3 4 1 (b) 1 2 3 4 (c) 4 3 2 1 (d) 3 4 2 1 U.P.P.C.S. (Mains) 2013 Ans. (a) The correctly matched list is as follows : Shubhas Chandra Bose - Haripura Session of Indian National Congress. Vallabhbhai Patel - Operation Polo Iqbal - Allahabad (Prayagraj) Session of Muslim League 1930 Batukeswar Dutt - Throwing of Bomb in Central Assembly. 240. The objective of the Butler Committee of 1927 was to : (a) Deﬁ ne the jurisdiction of the Central and Provincial Governments. (b) Deﬁ ne the powers of the Secretary of State for India. (c) Impose censorship on national press. (d) Improve the relationship between the Government of India and the Indian States. I.A.S. (Pre) 2017 Ans. (d) The Indian State Committee constituted a committee in the year 1927 under the Chairmanship of Sir Harcourt Butler, also known as the Butler Committee. The formation of this committee was about the investigation and classiﬁ cation of relationship between the Supreme power and the Native kings. The committee visited 16 states and submitted its report in the year 1929. After examining the existing relations of Supreme (British) power in Indian and princely states the Committee presented its recommendation regarding the ﬁ nancial and economic relation of these two. 241. When was the special rights and privy purse enjoyed by the Indian Pricely States abolished? (a) 1950 (b) 1949 (c) 1962 (d) 1971 M.P.P.C.S. (Pre.) 2020 Ans (d) Privy purse was a payment made to erstwhile Indian pricely states' ruling families by central government of India as part of their agreement to merge their states with the Republic of India in 1949 thereby ending their ruling rights. However all the special rights and privy purse enjoyed by Indian Pricely States were abolished by 26th Constitutional Amendment Act, 1971 in the year of 1971. 242. Who was the chairperson of ﬁ rst All India Socialist Youth Congress? (a) Subhash Chandra Bose (b) Acharya Narendra Dev (c) Jawahar Lal Nehru (d) J. B. Kriplani U.P. U.D.A./L.D.A. (Pre) 2013 Ans. (c) The ﬁ rst "All India Socialist Youth Congress" was organised in Calcutta on 27 December, 1928. This Congress was presided over by Pandit Jawahar Lal Nehru. 243. Who among the following were the founders of the “Hind Mazdoor Sabha” established in 1948? (a) B. Krishna Pillai, E.M.S. Namboodiripad and K.C. George (b) Jayaprakash narayan, Deen Dayal Upadhyay and M.N. Roy (c) C.P. Ramaswamy Iyer, K. Kamaraj and Veeresalingam Pantulu (d) Ashok Mehta, T.S. Ramanujam and G.G. Mehta I.A.S. (Pre) 2018 Ans. (d) Hind Mazdoor Sabha (HMS) was established during a trade union conference held in Calcutta in December, 1948. In this Indian Federation of Labour (estd. 1941), Hind Mazdoor Panchayat (HMP, estd 1948), unions of Forward Block and top most independent business unions also participated. During the founding conference Ramachandra Sakharam Ruikar was elected as ﬁ rst President and Ashok Mehta as General Secretary, G.G. Mehta and V.S. Mathur were se- lected as secretary. Maniben Kara and T.S. Ramanujan were chosen as Vice President of HMS and R.A. Khedagikar was selected treasurer. 244. Alipore Central Jail is situated at – (a) Mumbai (b) Kolkata (c) Chennai (d) Delhi Uttarakhand U.D.A./L.D.A. (Pre) 2007 Ans. (b) Alipore Central Jail is located in Kolkata. It was established in 1906. Political Prisoners were imprisoned here during British India rule. 245. ‘’Operation Polo’’ is associated/connected with : (a) Quit India Movement (b) Civil Disobedience Movement (c) Military Action in Junagarh State (d) Military Action in Hyderabad State U.P. U.D.A./L.D.A. (Pre) 2013 Ans. (d) Operation Polo, the code name of the Hyderabad military action was a military operation in September, 1948 in which the Indian Armed Forces invaded the State of Hyderabad and overthrew its Nizam, annexing the state into the Indian Union. 246. The ‘Secretariat Building’ of which State is known as "Writer’s Building"? (a) Assam (b) West Bengal (c) Maharashtra (d) Karnataka U.P.P.C.S. (Pre) 2013 Ans. (b) The Secretariat building of West Bengal is known as "Writer’s Building". It is located in Kolkata and was architected by Thomas Lyon. It was originally constructed for Junior servants (Writers) of British East India Company in 1777. 247. Which one of the famous buildings of New Delhi has been converted into Prime Ministers Museum? (a) India Habitate Centre (b) Talkatora Stadium (c) Vigyan Bhavan (d) Teen Murti Bhavan U.P.P.C.S. (Pre) 2022 Ans. (d) The residence of India’s ﬁ rst Prime Minister Jawaharlal Nehru was converted into a memorial after his death in 1964. Teen Murti Bhawan, has been refurbished over the past three years as the new 'Prime Ministers Museum' building in the complex that was inaugurated by Prime Minister Narendra Modi on April 14, 2022 welcomed visitors for the ﬁ rst time. 248. Karl Marx explained the process of class struggle with the help of which one of the following theories? (a) Empirical liberalism (b) Existentialism (c) Darwin’s theory of evolution (d) Dialectical materialism I.A.S. (Pre) 2011 Ans. (d) Karl Marx explained the process of class struggle with the help of dialectical materialism. According to Marx, in the process of historical chronology, "Slavery" was the base of ancient society. "Land" was the base of Feudal Society and "Capital" was the base of middle-class society. It is his "Materialistic description of History" According to Marx, the history of society is determined by economic causes which inherit class struggle. 249. Which statement is not true about Mother Teresa? (a) She was born in Albania. (b) She became a nun at the age of 18 years. (c) She was not an Indian citizen at the time of her death. (d) She was once a teacher in Calcutta. U.P. Lower Sub. (Spl) (Pre) 2004 Ans. (c) Mother Teresa was born in 1910 in Albania (North Macedonia) and at the age of 18, she had taken the membership of a missionary. She came to India in 1929 and started teaching at St. Mary's high School, Kolkata. She was an Indian citizen at the time of her death on September 5, 1997. 250. Religious Organisation established by Mother Teresa is called : (a) Sisters of Charity (b) Missionaries of Charity (c) Organisation of love (d) Charity for all 38th B.P.S.C. (Pre) 1992 Ans. (b) The Religious organisation established by Mother Teresa is called "Missionaries of Charity". 251. China occupied Tibet in: (a) 1960 (b) 1959 (c) 1961 (d) 1962 M.P.P.C.S. (Pre) 2006 Ans. (b) China occupied Tibet in 1959. The autonomy of Tibet ended in 1959. 252. In which year did the USSR become Russia? (a) 1989 (b) 1990 (c) 1991 (d) 1992 R.A.S./R.T.S.(Pre) 2003 Ans. (c) The Soviet Union disintegrated in ﬁ fteen separate countries along with Russia on 26 December, 1991. 253. Bangladesh was established as an independent nation after the Indo-Pakistan War of : (a) December, 1970 (b) March, 1970 (c) March, 1971 (d) December, 1971 M.P.P.C.S. (Pre) 2014 Ans. (d) Movement of Independence of Bangladesh started from 26 March, 1971. The war between India and Pakistan held in December, 1971. On December 16, 1971 East Pakistan after achieving independence from Pakistan in the Liberation War, became Bangladesh. 254. When occurred uniﬁ cation of Germany? (a) 2 October, 1990 (b) 3 October, 1990 (c) 5 October, 1990 (d) 10 October, 1990 M.P.P.C.S. (Pre) 1991 Ans. (b) Germany was divided in Russia inﬂ uenced Eastern Germany and the USA inﬂ uenced West Germany after the Second World War. Germany reintegrated on 3 October, 1990. 255. The main cause of participation of the USA in 2nd World War, 1941 was:- (a) War occurred between European powers (b) American Bankers had loans Germany (c) Neutral Foreign policy of USA (d) Invasion at Pearl Harbour R.A.S./R.T.S. (Pre) 1992 Ans. (d) Second World War began on 1st September, 1939 by the invasion of Germany over Polland but United States of America was not involved militarily. But, after a sudden attack of Japan at Pearl Harbor which was the naval base of United States of America, on 7 December, 1941, United States of America also participated in the Second World War militarily. 256. First President of United States of America was : (a) George Washington (b) John Adams (c) Abraham Lincoln (d) J.F. Kennedy Uttarakhand U.D.A./L.D.A. (Pre) 2007 Ans. (a) First President of the USA was George Washington who served from 1789 to 1797. 257. Which of the following was the President of United States of America who have resigned from the post of President? (a) Bill Clinton (b) Richard Nixon (c) George W. Bush (d) None of above Uttarakhand U.D.A./L.D.A. (Pre) 2007 Ans. (b) Richard Nixon was the 37th President of USA. He is the only U.S. President to resign the ofﬁ ce due to his role in Watergate Scandal. 258. Which country is concerned to Bishop Desmond Tutu ? (a) South Africa (b) Nicaragua (c) Mauritius (d) Namibia M.P.P.C.S. (Pre) 1990 Ans. (a) Bishop Desmond Tutu was black bishop of South Africa who achieved worldwide fame for anti-racism movement in the decade of the 1980's. He was awarded the Nobel Peace Prize in 1984 and Gandhi Peace Prize in 2005. 259. Who is credited with making of real paper in China? (a) Tsai-lun (b) Va Waugh (c) Chin (d) Kun-zun R.A.S./R.T.S. (Pre) 1994 Ans. (a) First paper making is credited to Tsai-Lun in China. Tsai Lun made paper in 105 A.D. 260. Which statement is correct? (a) Socrates was disciple of Plato (b) Plato was disciple of Socrates (c) Plato was disciple of Aristotle (d) Socrates & Plato were disciples of Aristotle M.P. P.C.S. (Pre) 1999 Ans. (b) The famous Greek philosopher Plato was a disciple of Socrates whereas Aristotle was the disciple of Plato. Plato deliberated on justice and concept of ‘’Ideal State’’ in his popular Book "The Republic". 261. The main cause of Italian Renaissance was : (a) Scientiﬁ c development in Italy (b) Highly developed Education (c) Freedom to express ideas (d) Secular traditions R.A.S./R.T.S. (Pre) 1994 Ans. (c) Italian Renaissance started in the 14th century is known as the beginning of modern era and termination of the medieval Feudalised era. The main cause of the Italian Renaissance was the freedom to express ideas. 262. The people known as 'Kallar' in the context of the rebellions in British India belonged to which of the following regions? (a) Kolhapur (b) Midnapore (c) Madurai (d) Rangpur U.P. P.C.S. (Mains) 2017 Ans. (c) 'Kallar' belonged to the tribal community of South India. In British India, the 'Kallar' tribe revolted against the British. This tribe was related to Madurai and surrounding area of South India. 263. The Act of 1909 was associated with : (a) introduction of separate electorate (b) decentralization (c) dyarchy (d) legislative councils M.P.P.C.S. (Pre) 2017 Ans. (a) The Act of 1909 was associated with introduction of seperate electrote for Muslims. 264. Name the revolutionary woman, who participated in the Peasant Movement of Bijoliya and was arrested. She also participated in 1930 Satyragrah and 1932 Civil Disobedience Movement and was sentenced to Jail – (a) Rama Devi (b) Ratan Shashtri (c) Anjana Devi Chaudhary (d) Kishori Devi R.A.S./R.T.S. (Pre.) 2021 Ans (a) Rama Devi Choudhary, adoringly called Maa (Mother) by the people of Odisha, was a celebrated freedom ﬁ ghter and a social reformer. Born on 3rd December, 1899 at Satyabhamapur (Cuttak), she met Gandhiji and Kasturba on 23rd March, 1921 and this changed her life. She participated in 1930 salt Satyagrah and Civil Disobedience movement and was arrested more than once. 265. Match List-I with List-II and select the correct answer using the codes given below the lists : List-I List-II (Political Parties) (Year) A. Indian National Congress 1. 1951 B. Bhartiya Jan Sangh 2. 1972 C. Communist Party of India 3. 1885 D. A.I.A.D.M.K. 4. 1925 Codes : A B C D (a) 3 1 4 2 (b) 2 3 4 1 (c) 4 3 2 1 (d) 2 1 4 3 U.P. R.O./A.R.O. (Mains) 2018 Ans. (a) Correct matched is : List-I List-II (Political Parties) (Year) Indian National Congress 1885 Bhartiya Jan Sangh 1951 Communist Party of India 1925 A.I.A.D.M.K. 1972 266. Who was the compiler of the “Imperial Gazetteer”? (a) Colin Clark (b) William Wilson Hunter (c) Charles Elliot (d) William Digly U.P.R.O./A.R.O. (Pre) (Re-Exam) 2016 Ans (b) William Wilson Hunter was a member of Indian Civil Services. He compiled the 'Imperial Gazetteer of India'. 267. The nomenclature of rural local governments as 'Panchayati Raj' was the result of the suggestion of which Indian leader? (a) Jawaharlal Nehru (b) Dr. Rajendra Prasad (c) Sardar Patel (d) M.K. Gandhi U.P. R.O./A.R.O. (Mains) 2017 Ans. (d) The nomenclature of rural local governments as 'Panchayati Raj' was the result of the suggestion of Mahatma Gandhi. Gandhiji believed that villages should not be 'just economically independent but also politically and administratively independent too. 268. Which is the ﬁ rst month of Indian National Calendar? (a) Phalgun (b) Magh (c) Paush (d) Chaitra U.P.R.O./A.R.O. (Pre) (Re-Exam) 2016 Ans (d) First month of Indian National Calendar is 'Chaitra' which coincides with March and April of the Gregorian Calendar. Phalgun is the last month.
questions.explanation_hi: सही उत्तर: (A) लखनऊ समझौता दिसंबर 1916 में लखनऊ में आयोजित दोनों दलों के संयुक्त सत्र में भारतीय राष्ट्रीय कांग्रेस और मुस्लिम लीग के बीच हुए समझौते को संदर्भित करता है। 5 मार्च, 1931 को गांधी-इरविन समझौता, 1945 में शिमला समझौता और 1932 में पूना समझौता। वर्ष 1945 में, एक अफवाह फैली कि कांग्रेस और मुस्लिम लीग के बीच भूलाभाई देसाई - लियाकत अली समझौते के माध्यम से गठबंधन हुआ था। छत्तीसगढ़ पी.सी.एस. की संशोधित उत्तरकुंजी में इस प्रश्न को मूल्यांकन से हटा दिया गया है। 228.निम्नलिखित में से कौन सा जोड़ा सही सुमेलित नहीं है? (ए) फतेह सिंह राठौड़ - टाइगर मैन (बी) सुरेश तेंदुलकर - राजनीतिक वैज्ञानिक (सी) मणि कनाल - फिल्म निर्माता (डी) आर.एस. शर्मा - इतिहासकार आर.ए. एस./आर.टी.एस. (पूर्व) 2013 उत्तर. (बी) सुरेश तेंदुलकर एक अर्थशास्त्री हैं, राजनीतिक वैज्ञानिक नहीं। अन्य जोड़े सही ढंग से सुमेलित हैं। इस प्रकार, विकल्प (बी) सही ढंग से सुमेलित नहीं है। 229. सही मिलान करें. A. बारडोली 1. महाराष्ट्र B. चौरी-चौरा 2. गुजरात C. यरवदा 3. पश्चिम बंगाल D. नोआखाली 4. उत्तर प्रदेश ए बी सी डी (ए) 1 2 3 4 (बी) 2 1 4 3 (सी) 2 4 1 3 (डी) 4 3 1 2 48वीं से 52वीं बी.पी.एस.सी. (पूर्व) 2008 उत्तर. (ए) राष्ट्रीय गीत वंदे मातरम् की रचना बंकिम चंद्र चटर्जी ने मूल रूप से बंगाली में की थी। (बी) शक संवत पर आधारित भारत के राष्ट्रीय कैलेंडर में सामान्यतः 22 मार्च को पहला चैत्र और लीप वर्ष में 21 मार्च होता है। (सी) भारत के राष्ट्रीय ध्वज का डिज़ाइन 22 जुलाई 1947 को संविधान सभा द्वारा अपनाया गया था। (डी) रवीन्द्रनाथ टैगोर द्वारा मूल रूप से बंगाली में रचित गीत जन-गण-मन को 24 जनवरी 1950 को संविधान सभा द्वारा इसके हिंदी संस्करण में राष्ट्रगान के रूप में अपनाया गया था। आई.ए.एस. (पूर्व) 2003 उत्तर. (मुख्य) 2007 उत्तर. 'ऑपरेशन विजय' किस राष्ट्र के विरुद्ध चलाया गया था? (ए) चीन (बी) बांग्लादेश (सी) नेपाल (डी) पाकिस्तान उत्तराखंड यू.डी.ए./एल.डी.ए. (पूर्व) 2007 उत्तर. (मेन्स) 2005 यू.पी.पी.सी.एस. (मुख्य) 2010 उत्तर.
